bm_desc: Hyundai Motor India Limited has submitted the Exchange a copy Srutinizers report and Voting Results of  Annual General Meeting held on August 26, 2026. Further, the company has informed the Exchange regarding voting results.

Hyundai Motor India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 30, 2026, titled "Press Release on Un-audited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026 - Intimation under Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 ".
Hyundai Motor India Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended Jun 30, 2026.
